policy: Main-series RPGs only. Every PokéAPI version is kept as a catalog identity so unsupported games answer with explicit coverage instead of borrowed facts. Tiers: validated = record-level validation performed; imported = full structured import from the pinned source; catalog = identity only, facts deliberately not imported; excluded = not a main-series RPG.

catalog.red-japan: Japanese-only release sharing Red/Blue mechanics; PokéAPI treats it as its own version group. Not imported to avoid duplicating Red/Blue facts under a different identity.

excluded.colosseum: GameCube spin-off, not a main-series RPG.
excluded.xd: GameCube spin-off (XD: Gale of Darkness), not a main-series RPG.
excluded.champions: Battle-focused title without a main-series story; not in scope.

notes.lets-go-pikachu: Core series per Bulbapedia, but abilities, held items and breeding are absent; see mechanics pack.
notes.lets-go-eevee: Core series per Bulbapedia, but abilities, held items and breeding are absent; see mechanics pack.
notes.legends-arceus: Core series with heavily divergent mechanics (no abilities, held items, breeding or TMs).
notes.legends-za: Core series with divergent mechanics (no abilities or breeding; real-time battles).
notes.mega-dimension: Downloadable expansion of Legends: Z-A recorded by PokéAPI as a version.
notes.the-isle-of-armor-sword: Expansion pseudo-version recorded by PokéAPI; shares Sword/Shield mechanics.
notes.the-isle-of-armor-shield: Expansion pseudo-version recorded by PokéAPI; shares Sword/Shield mechanics.
notes.the-crown-tundra-sword: Expansion pseudo-version recorded by PokéAPI; shares Sword/Shield mechanics.
notes.the-crown-tundra-shield: Expansion pseudo-version recorded by PokéAPI; shares Sword/Shield mechanics.
notes.the-teal-mask-scarlet: Expansion pseudo-version recorded by PokéAPI; shares Scarlet/Violet mechanics.
notes.the-teal-mask-violet: Expansion pseudo-version recorded by PokéAPI; shares Scarlet/Violet mechanics.
notes.the-indigo-disk-scarlet: Expansion pseudo-version recorded by PokéAPI; shares Scarlet/Violet mechanics.
notes.the-indigo-disk-violet: Expansion pseudo-version recorded by PokéAPI; shares Scarlet/Violet mechanics.

inherits_policy: Version groups listed here have no learnset, machine, move or item rows of their own in the source; PokéAPI records expansion content under the base game's version group. Facts are taken from the base group and marked partial.
